sql_query:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN cust.order_count = 1 THEN '1_purchase' ELSE '>1_purchases' END AS purchase_frequency,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
) cust
GROUP BY CASE WHEN cust.order_count = 1 THEN '1_purchase' ELSE '>1_purchases' END
ORDER BY purchase_frequency;
